verdict: Ads restarted strong; early results are promising but need more time.
narrative: After 22 days without active spend, your Meta campaign resumed on October 23rd and delivered all 11 leads over just three days at $13.23 per lead — a solid early cost, though three days is too short a window to call it a confirmed baseline. Google Business Profile generated 171 actions this period, with map-pack visibility trending up 10.6% over the last 7 days, but most of that traffic is driving directions rather than phone calls. We're monitoring call connection rates from the recent leads closely, as early data shows roughly half of calls placed are connecting — a contact-speed review is underway. Expect a clearer picture of cost-per-lead efficiency next period once the campaign has had a full week of continuous run time.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all arriving in the first 3 days after your campaign restarted
cost per lead on Meta this period — early and encouraging, not yet confirmed as a steady rate
actions from your Google Business Profile listings this period, up 10.6% in the last 7 days

watch_item.issue: Lead pipeline intake is unverifiable this week due to a CRM authentication issue, meaning the 11 leads may not be fully visible in your contact system.
watch_item.fix: The connection error has been identified and is being resolved so every incoming lead is confirmed captured before next report.
